description: This file contains utility functions for scripting, primarily for interacting with Android Debug Bridge (adb). It includes functions for error handling, logging, process management, port finding, and temporary file creation, tailored for use within a larger Android development or testing environment.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Terminates the script with an error message printed to stderr.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints a warning message to stderr.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Prints an informational message to stderr.

methods.name: do_adb
methods.description: Wraps the adb command with options.

methods.name: get_last_logcat_timestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last logcat entry.

methods.name: resolve_pid
methods.description: Resolves a process name or PID to an actual PID.

methods.name: find_open_port
methods.description: Finds an open local port starting from a given number.

methods.name: make_temp_file
methods.description: Creates a uniquely named temporary file.
